summary: The Colorado Mining Association, represented by Manager David R. Cole, objects to the proposed regulations implementing Executive Order 11644, arguing they would adversely affect prospecting and mining on public lands. Cole contends that a permit system for ORV use in mining would unduly hinder legitimate mineral exploration and development, noting that ORV needs often cannot be anticipated far in advance and that permit applications would reveal confidential exploration plans to competitors.

statement.opening_anchor: The Colorado Mining Association is the principal organization of individuals and companies engaged in exploration, mining and sales of mineral products in Colorado.
statement.closing_anchor:
Thank you for the opportunity to bring these views to your attention.

Sincerely yours,

COLORADO MINING ASSOCIATION

David R. Cole
Manager

summary_quote: The Colorado Mining Association objects to regulations currently under consideration. These regulations would have an adverse effect on prospecting for and mining of minerals on public lands.
